meta.title: State of the field: fast-moving solar numbers
meta.description: One row per fast-moving figure. Each row: { id, group, label, value (number, or null when the figure is read from another dataset), unit, as_of (date of the underlying measurement or data year: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-Qn), from (optional: { dataset, pick } — the page reads the latest value from that dataset: 'last' = last [year, value] pair, 'capacity_gw.last', 'capacity_gw.diff' = last minus previous, 'World.solar_share_elec.last'), detail, source (bibliography id), last_verified (YYYY-MM-DD) }. Record efficiencies are also in efficiency-records.json.

data.label: Crystalline silicon cell record
data.detail: LONGi hybrid interdigitated back-contact (HIBC) cell, certified by ISFH. Silicon's own practical limit is about 29.4 %.

data.label: Perovskite single-junction cell record
data.detail: Hainan University, 0.05 cm² cell, listed in the Solar cell efficiency tables (Version 68, May 2026). Earlier in 2026 the company SolaEon announced 27.87 % for a 0.076 cm² cell certified by China's NPVM.

data.label: Perovskite-on-silicon tandem cell record
data.detail: LONGi, certified by the European Solar Test Installation (ESTI).

data.label: Highest efficiency of any solar cell
data.detail: Fraunhofer ISE four-junction III-V cell under 665 suns of concentrated light.

data.label: Average commercial silicon module efficiency
data.detail: Weighted average of wafer-based crystalline-silicon modules sold. The best certified full-size silicon module in the efficiency tables reached 26.4 % in 2026.

data.label: Solar module price
data.detail: Average selling price of crystalline-silicon modules; from 2010 the series follows IRENA's benchmark prices for modules sold in Europe.

data.label: Module price learning rate
data.detail: Fraunhofer ISE's price-experience-curve fit over the past 45 years (Photovoltaics Report of 14 July 2026, slide 'Price Experience Curve'; the report's executive summary rounds it to 26.7 %). Our own fit to OWID prices and IRENA capacity for 2000–2024 gives about 28 %.

data.label: Solar capacity installed worldwide
data.detail: Cumulative capacity at the end of the year.

data.label: Solar capacity added in the year
data.detail: Difference between two year-end totals (net additions).

data.label: Solar share of world electricity
data.detail: Share of all electricity generated worldwide.

data.label: Cost of electricity from new solar PV
data.detail: Global weighted-average levelised cost of electricity (LCOE) for projects commissioned that year.
